metadata.remarks:
Data Core defines the foundational capability that establishes what constitutes institutional data and who is responsible for its governance. It defines data ownership, stewardship, scope, and baseline expectations, providing the legitimacy required before classification, handling, encryption, or retention controls are applied.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern is the authoritative anchor for SSPPs, standards, procedures, guidelines, and assurance related to the definition and governance of institutional data. All other data protection patterns assume data-core has been established.

components.title: Data Definition

implemented-requirements.remarks: Define the scope and boundaries of institutional information resources.

components.title: Data Ownership and Stewardship
components.description: Assignment of accountability for data governance, protection, and decision-making.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Assign roles and responsibilities for managing and protecting data.

components.title: Data Scope and Boundaries
components.description: Definition of where institutional data exists and the boundaries within which it is governed.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Identify data locations, flows, and trust boundaries.

components.title: Baseline Data Trust Assumptions
components.description: Minimum assumptions and expectations for handling and governing institutional data.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Establish baseline assumptions for the management and protection of data.
